About N1C4

Crafted with precision. Built around you.

N1C4 Barber Studio is a premium grooming studio in Midtown Miami. Every visit starts with a conversation about what you want, and ends with a cut finished to the last detail.

  • Personalized attention from the first consultation
  • Precision haircuts and professional barbering
  • Close attention to detail on every line
  • A relaxing grooming experience
  • Comfort and hospitality for every client
